create_gym_env: create a gym environment by calling gym.make with a given environment name string
create_env: create a batch of GymEnv wrapped environments with TimeLimit and optional seed for evaluation
create_train_env: create a batch of GymEnvInf wrapped environments with TimeLimit for infinite training episodes
create_agent: create a ReinforceAgent instance with a given model and number of actions
run_experiment: run an A2C Experiment on CartPole-v0 with multiprocessing spawn mode and configurable hyperparameters
